parameters.query: SELECT locationID as id, name, latitude as lat, longitude as lng, COALESCE(hints, puzzle_text, description) as clue FROM Locations WHERE is_active = TRUE AND locationID = {{ $json.body.locationId || 1 }} LIMIT 1;
SELECT u.id FROM users u JOIN sessions s ON s.userId = u.id WHERE s.token = '{{ $input.first().json.headers.authorization.replace("Bearer ", "").trim() }}' LIMIT 1;

UPDATE user_progress SET currentStep = {{ $('Build Response').first().json.nextLocationId || $('Build Response').first().json.currentLocationId }} WHERE userId = (SELECT id FROM users u JOIN sessions s ON s.userId = u.id WHERE s.token = '{{ $input.first().json.headers.authorization.replace("Bearer ", "").trim() }}' LIMIT 1);

SELECT locationID as id, name, latitude as lat, longitude as lng, COALESCE(hints, puzzle_text, description) as clue FROM Locations WHERE is_active = TRUE AND locationID = {{ $json.nextLocationId || 999 }} LIMIT 1;
